name: Momentum Trend + Pullback/Breakout Dual-Entry
description: Long-term outperformance via strong momentum leaders with dual-entry setups and dynamic SMA exits
entry_rule: (close >= 15) & (spy_close > spy_sma_50) & (close > sma_200) & (sma_50 > sma_200) & (sma_10 > sma_20) & (sma_20 > sma_50) & (close / lag(close, 126) >= 1.50) & (atr_20 / close >= 0.025) & (rsi_14 >= 35) & (rsi_14 <= 70) & (volume >= vol_sma_20 * 1.2) & ((abs(close - sma_10) / sma_10 <= 0.02) | (abs(close - sma_20) / sma_20 <= 0.02) | (abs(close - sma_50) / sma_50 <= 0.02) | (close > high_20))
entry_rule_long: (close >= 15) & (spy_close > spy_sma_50) & (close > sma_200) & (sma_50 > sma_200) & (sma_10 > sma_20) & (sma_20 > sma_50) & (close / lag(close, 126) >= 1.50) & (atr_20 / close >= 0.025) & (rsi_14 >= 35) & (rsi_14 <= 70) & (volume >= vol_sma_20 * 1.2) & ((abs(close - sma_10) / sma_10 <= 0.02) | (abs(close - sma_20) / sma_20 <= 0.02) | (abs(close - sma_50) / sma_50 <= 0.02) | (close > high_20))
exit_rule: ((abs(sma_10 - sma_20) / sma_20 > 0.05) & (close < sma_10)) | ((abs(sma_10 - sma_20) / sma_20 <= 0.05) & (close < sma_20))
